# Vendored archify 3.2.0 (JAgentDesk)

Renders the agent activity graph (spec `31-agent-activity-graph`, ADR-0031):
the Flow view as a `lifecycle` (schema 3, automatic layout) and the Plan view
as a `tree`. Called only through
`src/server/agent/activity-graph/activity-graph-renderer.ts`, which runs one
renderer script per render as a child process of the daemon's own runtime.

Team-mode diagrams (spec `23`, ADR-0021) keep using `../archify` (3.0.1): the
3.2.0 lifecycle renderer accepts only `schema_version: 3`, which would reject
saved Team-mode lifecycle diagrams.

## Pinned upstream

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Project | archify, https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify (MIT, see `LICENSE`) |
| Version | 3.2.0 (last MIT release; later releases are Apache-2.0) |
| Upstream tag | `v3.2.0` |
| Upstream commit | `208acba8d412335185b2056fedf54b3405df43fb` |
| Source directory | `archify/` of that commit |

Upgrading is a reviewed change: re-copy the files listed below from a new tag,
re-apply the patches, update this table and run
`npx vitest run src/server/agent/activity-graph` in `packages/server`. A
release after 3.2.0 is Apache-2.0 and must ship upstream's `NOTICE`.

## What is included

Only what the two renderers import, copied byte-for-byte unless listed under
"Patches":

- `renderers/lifecycle/render-lifecycle.mjs`, `renderers/tree/render-tree.mjs`
  and the shared modules they import (`renderers/shared/*.mjs`, including the
  prebuilt schema validators in `generated-validators.mjs`).
- `assets/template.html`: the built viewer. `assets/JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt`:
  font license.
- `locales/*.json`: the viewer/renderer message catalogs `renderers/shared/i18n.mjs`
  reads at load time (package data, read relative to this directory only).
- `schemas/{common,lifecycle,tree}.schema.json`: reference for reviewers; not
  read at runtime.
- `LICENSE` (upstream MIT, unchanged) and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` (adjusted).

Not included: the CLI (`bin/`), `scripts/` (including the update check), the
other renderers, the explainer, viewer sources, examples, references, tests and
the brand-mark catalog.

## Patches

1. **Brand marks removed** (as in `../archify`).
   `renderers/shared/generated-brand-marks.mjs` is not copied;
   `renderers/shared/brand-marks.mjs` is the JAgentDesk stub from `../archify`
   with `tree` added to its collections: no mark is ever rendered, a `brand`
   field is rejected with `brand/unsupported`, and there is no HTTP/DNS code.
2. **No update check** (as in `../archify`): the CLI and `scripts/` are not
   vendored; the daemon also sets `ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1`.
3. **Wide lifecycle allowed on request.** `render-lifecycle.mjs` refuses a
   main path wider than a fitted desktop page can show at 6px text
   (`lifecycle/too-wide`, about six states). The activity graph is read in a
   pan/zoom frame, so the daemon sets `JAD_ARCHIFY_ALLOW_WIDE_LIFECYCLE=1` and
   that single gate is skipped; every other layout check still runs. Without
   the variable the renderer behaves as upstream.

## Runtime contract

- Environment per render: `ARCHIFY_DIAGNOSTIC_FORMAT=json`,
  `ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1`, `JAD_ARCHIFY_ALLOW_WIDE_LIFECYCLE=1`;
  `ARCHIFY_REPO_ROOT` and `ARCHIFY_QUALITY_PROFILE` are removed.
- Input is generated by the daemon from the agent stream; `meta.output` is a
  temporary file name. Nothing is written outside a temporary directory.
- Packaging: `npm run build:lib` copies this directory to
  `dist/server/vendor/archify-3.2.0`; the desktop app unpacks it from
  `app.asar` (`packages/desktop/electron-builder.yml`, `asarUnpack`).
